question: Which of the following correctly depicts Indian Standard Time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GMT + 5.30.**__

 
• Indian Standard Time is plus 5.30 hours from the GMT.
 
• The Indian Standard Time is calculated from 82°30’E meridian passing through Mirzapur.
 
• It does not take into account daylight saving time along with other seasonal factors.
